lines.speaker: stasis_broker
lines.text: Premium sleepers on the left. Labour batch on the right. All pods are legally acquired in at least one jurisdiction.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: And the woman in the scratched pod?

lines.speaker: stasis_broker
lines.text: Unknown contract officer. Twelve crates if you want the gamble. Eight buys the ordinary labour batch, three crew guaranteed.

lines.speaker: stasis_broker
lines.text: Tap gently. The glass is worth more than several customers.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: The sleeper moves slightly behind the frost.

lines.speaker: stasis_broker
lines.text: Lucky draw. Her records decrypt cleanly: Sera Vale, logistics officer. The pod is yours.

lines.speaker: stasis_broker
lines.text: The pod opens, but the records are useless. One healthy worker steps out and asks where the galley is.

lines.speaker: stasis_broker
lines.text: Three labour contracts, three warm bodies, no surprises. Sensible choice.

lines.speaker: stasis_broker
lines.text: Window shopping is free. Touching the refrigeration controls is not.

options.line: I will take the scratched pod.
I am not buying frozen strangers today.
Fine. I will take her pod.
I will take the labour batch instead.
